notes.short: Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, then back to Ashkelon
notes.about: Three cities are named, Ashkelon, Gaza and Ekron, and then taken up in reverse: Ekron's hope will wither, Gaza will lose its king, and Ashkelon will be uninhabited.

lines.words: There will cease to be a king in Gaza,

notes.evidence: Boys gives the verse as an introverted arrangement of six members: Ashkelon in the first and last, Gaza in the second and fifth, Ekron in the third and fourth.

cites.quote: The instances of introverted arrangement which have hitherto been given in the present work, consist of no more than four members each. There are, however, similar ones of six members, or more. … Here we have Ashkelon in a. and a., Gaza in b. and b., Ekron in c. and c.
cites.read: the 1825 printing, in the scan at archive.org/details/akeytobookpsalm00boysgoog
